tasks.title: Nmap NetBIOS Scripts
tasks.description: 139 carries the same SMB protocol as 445 over a legacy NetBIOS session transport — the main extra value here is the NetBIOS name/workgroup info, which can leak the computer name and domain even when 445 is firewalled off.

tasks.title: NetBIOS Name & Domain Lookup
tasks.description: Grab the computer name, domain/workgroup, and logged-on user hint directly — useful recon before you've authenticated anywhere.

tasks.title: Everything Else Lives in the SMB Methodology
tasks.description: Null sessions, share listing, RPC enumeration, password spraying, and all the lateral-movement/credential-dumping techniques are the same regardless of whether you reach SMB over 139 or 445 — see the SMB (445) page rather than duplicating it here. Just point smbclient/rpcclient at the same IP; it works over either port.
